# SkinLabs®

> South African skincare intelligence infrastructure: AI-powered skin
> analysis, independently reviewed products, ingredient science, and a
> normalized skincare-product database, built for South African skin
> tones, climate and retail availability. Not a content subscription --
> the product is a free-first, first-party skin-profile and product-
> knowledge system, with selective membership monetisation layered on top.

## Core content

- [Skin Analysis (SKYNN AI)](https://skinlabs.co.za/skynn-ai): free AI
  skin analysis (photo + self-reported Monk Skin Tone + quiz), grounded,
  SA-context AM/PM routine recommendations from real reviewed products --
  never a fabricated recommendation.
- [Reviews](https://skinlabs.co.za/reviews): independently scored South
  African and globally-available skincare product reviews (70% SA brands),
  editorially independent from monetisation.
- [Briefings](https://skinlabs.co.za/briefings): dermatology-grounded news
  and explainer articles.
- [Ingredients](https://skinlabs.co.za/ingredients): ingredient directory,
  detail pages, and a conflict/interaction checker
  ([/ingredients/checker](https://skinlabs.co.za/ingredients/checker)),
  sourced from DermNet NZ, JAAD and other cited dermatology literature.
- [Knowledge Hub](https://skinlabs.co.za/knowledge-hub): skincare FAQ and
  education content.
- [Spotlight](https://skinlabs.co.za/spotlight): a recurring, methodology-
  versioned brand ranking/editorial feature.
- [Seasonal Guides](https://skinlabs.co.za/seasonals): climate- and season-
  specific skincare guidance for South Africa's four seasons.
- [The Skin Deep podcast](https://skinlabs.co.za/podcast): editorial audio
  content, transcribed and indexed per episode.
- [OpenHaus marketplace](https://skinlabs.co.za/marketplace): an in-app
  skincare marketplace, sourced from verified wholesale catalogues.

## Standing editorial principles (apply to every page above)

Never fabricated: social proof, scarcity, product data, reviews, ratings,
performance claims, or clinical/diagnostic claims. Every AI-generated
recommendation is grounded in a real, reviewed product or a real cited
source -- never invented. Unshipped features are explicitly labelled
"Coming soon," never presented as operational.

## Machine-readable indexes

- [Sitemap](https://skinlabs.co.za/sitemap.xml): every canonical,
  indexable URL on the site, programmatically generated at build time from
  the same content sources above.
- [Podcast RSS feed](https://skinlabs.co.za/podcast.xml): RSS 2.0 +
  iTunes namespace, per-episode duration/transcript metadata.

## Access

- `/admin` and `/dashboard` are authenticated, user-specific surfaces --
  intentionally excluded from indexing (see /robots.txt).
- Every other path listed in /sitemap.xml is public and intended to be
  crawled, cited and linked to.
